
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/bugshare/p/19788437" title="发布于 2026-03-28 19:37">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">你的终端神器之Oh My Zsh</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>想不想让你的终端变得更漂亮且实用呢，来试试这款神器--<strong>Oh My Zsh</strong>。<br>
安装完成后，每次在命令提示符中敲击键盘，你都能体验到数百个强大的插件和精美的主题。</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh</a></p>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2026-03-28_17-18-22.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202603/3715916-20260328193658650-438427922.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1 id="先决条件">先决条件</h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p>操作系统：Linux、macOS、Windows(WSL2)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Zsh：v4.3.9 或更高版本（运行 <code>zsh --version</code> 命令确认）</p>
<ul>
<li>Linux安装：<code>apt install zsh</code></li>
<li>macOS安装：<code>brew install zsh</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>curl 或 wget</p>
<ul>
<li>基本基本自带curl</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>Git，推荐版本 <code>2.4.11</code> 或更高版本</p>
<ul>
<li>Linux安装：<code>apt install git</code></li>
<li>macOS安装：<code>brew install git</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><code>OhMyZsh</code>是Zsh的一种管理工具，在安装OhMyZsh之前首先得安装Zsh。</p>
<p><code>Git</code> 用来克隆（下载）其代码仓库并管理插件/主题。</p>
<p><code>brew</code>查看之前文章《用Mac的朋友们，你们都在使用Homebrew了吗》。</p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="基本安装">基本安装</h1>
<p>命令行安装</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># curl方式
sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh)"

# wget方式
sh -c "$(wget -O- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh)"
</code></pre>
<p>如果以上出现网络问题，国内环境可以使用以下链接：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># curl方式
sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://install.ohmyz.sh/)"

# wget方式
sh -c "$(wget -O- https://install.ohmyz.sh/)"
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2026-03-28_17-23-02.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202603/3715916-20260328193658995-1342691476.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1 id="自带插件">自带插件</h1>
<p>Oh My Zsh 自带大量插件，可以到<code>~/.oh-my-zsh/plugins</code>目录查看。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>插件的详细介绍可以去 <a href="https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki/Plugins" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki/Plugins</a> 查看。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2026-03-28_17-31-16.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202603/3715916-20260328193658881-1675334962.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="启用插件">启用插件</h2>
<p>编辑 <code>vi ~/.zshrc</code>，添加插件名称以启用插件。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">plugins=(
  git
  macos
)
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><em>注意：插件之间用空格（空格、制表符、换行符等）分隔。<strong>请勿</strong>使用逗号，否则插件会出错</em></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="第三方插件">第三方插件</h1>
<p><a href="https://github.com/zsh-users" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/zsh-users</a></p>
<p>推荐两款我自用的：</p>
<ul>
<li>zsh-autosuggestions（<strong>自动补全</strong>）</li>
<li>zsh-syntax-highlighting（<strong>语法高亮</strong>）</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="下载插件">下载插件</h2>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># zsh-autosuggestions
git clone https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions ${ZSH_CUSTOM:-~/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/zsh-autosuggestions

# zsh-syntax-highlighting
git clone https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting.git ${ZSH_CUSTOM:-~/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/zsh-syntax-highlighting
</code></pre>
<h2 id="启用插件-1">启用插件</h2>
<pre><code class="language-shell">plugins=(
  # ...
  zsh-autosuggestions
  zsh-syntax-highlighting
)
</code></pre>
<h1 id="自带主题">自带主题</h1>
<p>Oh My Zsh 自带的主题非常丰富，可以到<code>~/.oh-my-zsh/themes</code>目录查看。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>主题对应的界面效果可以到 <a href="https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki/Themes" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki/Themes</a> 查看</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2026-03-28_17-51-08.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202603/3715916-20260328193659146-1821658147.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="启用主题">启用主题</h2>
<p>编辑 <code>vi ~/.zshrc</code>，更改你选择的主题名称。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">ZSH_THEME="robbyrussell"
</code></pre>
<h1 id="第三方主题">第三方主题</h1>
<p>如果自带主题没有满意的，你也可以使用第三方主题。</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k</a>，有人称为此主题为<strong>天和之作</strong>，不过此主题已经处于<strong>非活跃</strong>的状态了。</p>
<h2 id="安装字体">安装字体</h2>
<p><a href="https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k#meslo-nerd-font-patched-for-powerlevel10k" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k#meslo-nerd-font-patched-for-powerlevel10k</a></p>
<ol>
<li>下载字体文件（ttf ）:
<ul>
<li>[MesloLGS NF Regular.ttf](<a href="https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS</a> NF Regular.ttf)</li>
<li>[MesloLGS NF Bold.ttf](<a href="https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS</a> NF Bold.ttf)</li>
<li>[MesloLGS NF Italic.ttf](<a href="https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS</a> NF Italic.ttf)</li>
<li>[MesloLGS NF Bold Italic.ttf](<a href="https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k-media/raw/master/MesloLGS</a> NF Bold Italic.ttf)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>双击文件安装字体</li>
<li>配置终端字体
<ul>
<li><strong>Apple Terminal</strong>：打开<em>终端 → 偏好设置 → 描述文件 → 文本</em>，点击<em>字体</em>下的<em>“更改”</em> ，然后选择字体系列。<code>MesloLGS NF</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2026-03-28_18-29-11.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202603/3715916-20260328193656962-1284249463.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="安装主题">安装主题</h2>
<p>终端执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k.git "${ZSH_CUSTOM:-$HOME/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/themes/powerlevel10k"
</code></pre>
<p>国内环境：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">git clone --depth=1 https://gitee.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k.git "${ZSH_CUSTOM:-$HOME/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/themes/powerlevel10k"
</code></pre>
<h2 id="启用主题-1">启用主题</h2>
<pre><code class="language-shell">ZSH_THEME="powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k"
</code></pre>
<h2 id="配置主题">配置主题</h2>
<p>终端执行（重开终端或执行<code>source ~/.zshrc</code>）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">p10k configure
</code></pre>
<p>终端交互式，根据自己喜好选择即可。</p>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2026-03-28_18-43-03.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202603/3715916-20260328193658985-2137528940.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1 id="卸载oh-my-zsh">卸载Oh My Zsh</h1>
<p>如果安装后你觉得不好用，卸载也很简单。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">uninstall_oh_my_zsh
</code></pre>
<h1 id="资源监控">资源监控</h1>
<p>现在你的终端看上去已经很酷炫了，但在使用<code>top</code>时会显得很平庸，你可以安装一个更好看的工具<code>btop</code>。</p>
<h2 id="安装">安装</h2>
<p><a href="https://github.com/aristocratos/btop" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/aristocratos/btop</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># Linux
dnf install btop

# macOS
brew install btop
</code></pre>
<h2 id="验证">验证</h2>
<p>终端执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">btop
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2026-03-28_18-45-09.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202603/3715916-20260328193658987-328733657.png" class="lazyload"></p>
